result.finding: No XML application configuration files detected. The application uses Spring Boot's annotation-based auto-configuration exclusively. The only XML file in the project is pom.xml (Maven build descriptor), not an application configuration file.
evidence: Searched src/ directory: no XML files found (no applicationContext.xml, web.xml, hibernate.cfg.xml, persistence.xml, or mapper XML files)
Only XML file in project: pom.xml (Maven build descriptor, not application config)
Spring Boot auto-configuration via @SpringBootApplication in PhotoAlbumApplication.java (no XML Spring context required)
JPA configured via application.properties (spring.jpa.* properties) — no persistence.xml
